market_summary: USD strength drives GBPUSD into a clear breakdown below Value Area Low with heavy bearish CVD alignment. US100 continues its steady bullish trend structure above VWAP toward session extremes. XAUUSD, EURUSD, and BTCUSD remain in mid-range or divergent consolidation conditions awaiting London/NY transition catalysts.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 4040.95 to VAH 4060.33) and below POC 4047.0. CVD is BEARISH (-1.38) with negative slope (-0.77). SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. Price is currently below VWAP (4048.84) and EMA50 (4050.93) following a rejection from S/R 4052.38. Positioned mid-channel between ATR bounds without RVOL > 2.0 confirmation on recent bars. Lacks strong directional expansion momentum.

Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.11315 to VAH 1.11621) and close to VAL, below POC 1.11382. CVD is NEUTRAL (-1,490) with positive slope. SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. Price rejected from resistance at Prev Low (1.11456) and trades well below VWAP (1.11515) and EMA50 (1.11532). ATR is expanding and price is hugging the lower ATR band (1.11329), but RVOL remains normal (0.962) with no fresh volume spike to confirm a breakdown below Session Low 1.11307.

Price is below VAL 1.33196 and below POC 1.33473, demonstrating value area breakdown. CVD is BEARISH (-1,941) with negative slope (-519.53), fully supporting seller control. SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. Price is trending strongly below sloping VWAP (1.33312) and EMA50 (1.33344), riding along the lower ATR band (1.33100). RVOL is elevated at 1.813 with multiple recent volume spikes confirming persistent down-pressure towards Session Low (1.33070).
signals.level_event: acceptance below VAL 1.33196 and testing Session Low 1.3307

signals.rationale: Price is inside VA (VAL 28023.92 to VAH 28294.33) near VAH and well above POC 28115.86. CVD is BULLISH (+9.20) with positive slope (+0.91). SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. Price is holding strongly above VWAP (28092.21) and EMA50 (28095.76), pushing top ATR band (28287.87). US100 Dukascopy tick volume standardly lacks yellow RVOL > 2.0 spikes, but structural trend and order flow pressure remain strongly intact towards Session High 28294.33.

Price is above VAH 73828.35 and above POC 73660.4. CVD is slightly BEARISH (-0.04) with flat slope, showing mild divergence against price. SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. Price is above VWAP (73669.22) and EMA50 (73729.05), but rejected off S/R 73975.3 and Session High 74085.2. Trading mid-channel below upper ATR band (74197.37) without RVOL confirmation (0.985). Divergent CVD and overhead resistance warrant standing aside.
